# Write card files with 8.3 names from cached heap buffers

Long names and uncached source buffers produced empty files.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Firmware paths are 8.3 only. Write from a cached heap buffer, and only from task context.

> **What happens:** Empty (0-byte) log files.

**Symptoms:** [Wrong picture, screen or card file](index.md#wrong-output)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Early E-M5 III card logs came out empty until names were 8.3 and the buffer was cached heap memory. Source: [Gotchas](../sources/em5n.gotchas.md).
